Author correspondence: Correspondence with authors (hgoksever@yahoo.com) on 5/08/2025 requesting clarification on methods and other study details. No reply received.

Additional concerns and comments: 

  • Authors do not report a study/ recruitment timeframe and therefore, we can not verify whether the trial registration is prospective. Authors only note that participants were analysed for "for 2 years"
  • The description of randomisation and allocation concealment is vague "Patients were randomized by giving odd and even numbers to use microfluidic chip technique and swim-up technique."
  • Trial registration details masking as "Double (Participant/Investigator)" however how blinding was implemented is not detailed.
  • When assessing the publication and trial registration we noticed the following inconsistencies
    • Implantation rate was defined as a primary outcome in trial registration but was not reported or an explanation provided for omitting it from publication.
    • Authors include a description of density gradient centrifugation (DGC) in the methods. However, the use of DGC doesn't make sense to include when considering the other 2 groups.
  • As we were unable to verify the trial registration and noted inconsistencies above, we have major trustworthiness concerns about this study.
